messages:
Aisha: Morning team — quick async update.

What I did: pushed a small refactor to the SDK auth flow (PR #482), updated the quickstart README, and added macOS wheel notes.
Blockers: CI flake on macOS wheel build (failing on x86 -> arm env). Can't reproduce locally.
Today: triage CI, open repro issue if needed, pair with @Ben on samplekit packaging.

Ben: thanks — I can take a CI run after lunch. Can you paste the failing logs here? Also pinging @Elena for sample app env matrix.

Aisha: logs attached below: 
```
wheel build failed: error: invalid wheel tag: 'cp310-abi3-macosx_11_0_x86_64'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/wheel", line 7, in <module>
    ...
```

Carlos: quick note — left a comment on PR #482 about a token-refresh edge case, small suggestion.

Ben: @Aisha please add a CI job env var USE_MANYLINUX=1 and re-run. If it still fails I'll try the M1 runner later today.

Elena: sample app update: swapped example config to a 2-stage init to cut startup latency, pushed branch samplekit/fast-init. Need a docs blurb — @Aisha can you add a one-paragraph note to the quickstart? :pray: 

Aisha: will do. Any objections to keeping the old example in legacy.md for reference? :thinking: 

Carlos: fine to archive but include a migration note. Also — can someone do a smoke run against the Dedicated emulator? I saw a latency regression for long prompts earlier and want to rule out the SDK changes.

Ben: I'll schedule a smoke test after the CI run completes.

Devex Bot: Deploy bot: build 482 merged to staging by Aisha at 2026-03-17T09:12:08Z :rocket:

Aisha: leaving a short checklist here:
- add quickstart paragraph
- open CI repro issue if it still fails after @Ben run
- address Carlos' comment on PR #482
- add migration note to legacy.md

Ben: ack. I have a pairing slot at 2pm PT if you want to debug together.

Elena: 2pm PT works for me; I'll also draft a docs snippet for the init API to hand off.

Carlos: block resolved on my side, I'm back on the review queue.

Aisha: great — I'll update this thread after the CI run. :thumbsup:
